description: Compare exactly two companies side by side using the stable comparison projection (identity, province, CNAE, registry activity). Cheaper than fetching two full reports when the question is "which of these two ...". Both slugs must come from borme_search_companies.

slugs.description: Exactly two distinct company slugs to compare, e.g. ["empresa-a-sl","empresa-b-sl"].

items.description: Company slug, e.g. "telefonica-de-espana-sa". Get it from borme_search_companies (field `slug`).

name: borme_compare_companies
